items.title: Mango Markets exploiter charged over $110M scheme
items.content: The CFTC charged Avraham Eisenberg with fraud and market manipulation over the $110M Mango Markets exploit, alleging he manipulated the MNGO oracle price to drain the venue.

items.title: CFTC sues trader who drained $110M from a Solana perp exchange
items.content: US commodities regulators filed suit against the trader accused of draining 110 million dollars from a Solana perpetual exchange by pushing its oracle price, a scheme regulators say netted him about $110M.

items.title: Kelp DAO reports $8.2M drained from restaking vault
items.content: Kelp DAO said an attacker drained 8.2 million dollars from a restaking vault after compromising a signer key. Deposits and withdrawals are paused while the team traces the funds.

items.title: Kelp DAO reports $8.2M drained from restaking vault
items.content: Kelp DAO said an attacker drained 8.2 million dollars from a restaking vault after compromising a signer key. Deposits and withdrawals are paused while the team traces the funds. Update: 1,400 ETH traced to a mixer.

items.title: Ethereum researchers publish post-quantum signature roadmap
items.content: A draft roadmap proposes migrating validator signatures to a post-quantum scheme in three phases, with a testnet fork targeted once the aggregation scheme clears review.

items.title: Bitcoin funding rates flip negative as open interest drops 8%
items.content: Perp funding across major venues turned negative for the first time in three weeks while open interest fell 8%, a sign leveraged longs were flushed.

items.title: Dormant whale moves 12,000 BTC after six years
items.content: A wallet dormant since 2019 moved 12,000 BTC to a new address in three transactions; no venue deposit has been observed yet.

items.title: 12,000 BTC dormant since 2019 just moved
items.content: A wallet that had been inactive for six years transferred twelve thousand bitcoin across three transactions to a fresh address, with no exchange deposit seen so far.

items.title: Solana block production stalls for 40 minutes
items.content: Solana validators halted block production for roughly 40 minutes before a restart restored finality; the foundation attributed the stall to a consensus client bug.
